card.name: Linking words before inhaled anesthetic names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, in, with, to, via) right before a volatile anesthetic name such as sevoflurane, isoflurane or desflurane. Seen in anesthesia labels discussing concentration, pressure or delivery.

modes.label: Of/in before agent name
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'in' after a noun like concentration, pressure or rise, just before an anesthetic gas is named.
modes.example: requires equilibration of muscle with delivered partial pressure<< of>> sevoflurane.

modes.label: Comparison or delivery link
modes.description: With, to or via linking one anesthetic to another or to a delivery route.
modes.example: Therefore, during sevoflurane anesthesia, the dosage adjustments for these muscle relaxants are similar to those required<< with>> isoflurane.
